newsitem.title: GERMANY: BHW to be priced at 22-28 dmk in flotation.
newsitem.headline: BHW to be priced at 22-28 dmk in flotation.

text.p: BHW Holding AG, Germany's second largest construction financing group, will price its new shares between 22 and 28 marks in a share flotation this month, Dresdner Bank AG, one of the lead managers, said on Monday.
The final issue price will be announced on April 26 and the allocation will take place on April 27.
BHW is taking 30 percent of its planned 900 million-mark share capital public, or about 270 million marks.
The volume of the issue will be well above one billion marks, Dresdner Bank management board member Hansgeorg Hofmann told a news conference.

The subscription period runs from April 14 to April 25 and the shares will be placed internationally. Lead managers are Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Credit Suisse First Boston.
The flotation is being conducted through a bookbuilding procedure under which bids for the new issue are sought at indicative prices.
